title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Schedule: Carry-Forward Terms by Tier
content:
Carrying a season pass forward to the following season is published per tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme with three figures: whether the tier offers a carry-forward at all, the fee the tier carries for the election, and the number of calendar days after activation within which the election may be made.

| Tier | Carry-forward offered | Carry-forward fee (USD) | Election period (calendar days after activation) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | no | 95.00 | 14 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | no | 95.00 | 14 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | yes | 95.00 | 21 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | yes | 129.00 | 21 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | 129.00 | 30 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | 149.00 | 30 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | yes | 0.00 | 45 |

The fee column carries a published figure for all seven tiers, including the two on which a carry-forward is not offered. The Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass carries a fee of 0.00 and the longest election period in the programme, 45 calendar days.

The election period is a number of calendar days, counted on the tier's own figure; it is not a share of the season and does not move with the date the season opens.
